Prerequisites: Chemist 6

A creature struck by a psychoactive bomb takes a –1 penalty on saving throws against charm, emotion, fear, and pain effects, and the DC for Intimidate checks against the victim decreases by 2. This effect lasts for 1 hour per chemist level. These penalties do not stack, and a creature can only be affected by a single psychoactive bomb at a time. A psychoactive bomb deals 1d6 fewer hit points of damage than normal.

* This discovery modifies bombs. Discoveries marked with an asterisk do not stack; only one such discovery can be applied to an individual bomb.
